o: Some campers are cooking over a fire.

p5.s: The company's new tablet has been extremely ------- with university students.
p5.why: be + (trạng từ extremely) + tính từ: popular with = được ưa chuộng.

p5.s: By the time the guests arrived, the caterers ------- setting up the tables.
p5.why: Việc xong trước một mốc trong quá khứ (khách đã tới) → quá khứ hoàn thành: had finished.

p5.s: Applicants must have at least three years of ------- in customer service.
p5.why: years of experience = số năm kinh nghiệm.

p5.s: The committee will meet again ------- two weeks to review the proposals.
p5.why: in + khoảng thời gian = sau bao lâu nữa: in two weeks.

p5.s: Ms. Tanaka prefers to review the contracts -------.
p5.why: Tự mình làm → đại từ phản thân nhấn mạnh đứng cuối câu: herself.

p5.s: Ms. Kowalski spoke ------- about the importance of customer feedback.
p5.why: Bổ nghĩa cho động từ spoke cần trạng từ: persuasively.

p5.s: ------- the weather improves, the outdoor concert will be moved indoors.
p5.why: Trừ khi trời tốt lên, buổi hoà nhạc sẽ chuyển vào trong nhà → Unless.

p5.s: ------- employee will receive a copy of the updated handbook.
p5.why: Danh từ số ít employee đi với Each; All, Many, Several cần danh từ số nhiều.

p5.s: The new software ------- by all staff members starting next month.
p5.why: Phần mềm được dùng (bị động) từ tháng sau → tương lai bị động: will be used.

p5.s: The hotel offers a free shuttle service to guests who ------- their rooms online.
p5.why: reserve a room = đặt phòng.

p5.s: All requests for time off require the ------- of a supervisor.
p5.why: Sau mạo từ the và trước of cần danh từ: approval.

p5.s: Please submit your application no later than 5 P.M. ------- Friday.
p5.why: Trước thứ trong tuần dùng on: on Friday.

p5.s: Not only did the team finish early, ------- they also stayed under budget.
p5.why: Cấu trúc Not only … but (also) …: không những … mà còn …

p5.s: The clients asked that the documents be sent to ------- directly.
p5.why: Sau giới từ to cần đại từ tân ngữ: them.

p5.s: Dr. Feld will ------- her research findings at the medical conference in Oslo.
p5.why: present findings = trình bày kết quả nghiên cứu.

p5.s: The factory has become more ------- since it replaced its older machines.
p5.why: become + more + tính từ: more efficient.

p5.s: By the end of next year, Ms. Olsen ------- at the hospital for a decade.
p5.why: By the end of next year (mốc trong tương lai) + for a decade → tương lai hoàn thành: will have worked.

p5.s: Visitors may park in either the north lot ------- the south lot.
p5.why: either … or … = hoặc … hoặc …

p5.s: The hotel is conveniently located ------- walking distance of the convention center.
p5.why: within walking distance of = trong phạm vi đi bộ tới.

p5.s: Due to high -------, the concert sold out within an hour.
p5.why: high demand = nhu cầu cao → vé bán hết. high supply (nguồn cung lớn) không làm hết vé.

p5.s: Customers have responded ------- to the new store layout.
p5.why: Bổ nghĩa cho động từ responded cần trạng từ: positively.

p5.s: There is still ------- time to register for the workshop.
p5.why: time (thời gian) là danh từ không đếm được → some; many, few, several đi với danh từ đếm được số nhiều.

p5.s: If the shipment ------- by Friday, we will contact the supplier.
p5.why: Câu điều kiện loại 1: mệnh đề If dùng hiện tại đơn (does not arrive), mệnh đề chính dùng will.

p5.s: Our competitors lowered ------- prices last month.
p5.why: Trước danh từ prices cần tính từ sở hữu: their.

p5.s: Bring an umbrella ------- it rains during the outdoor ceremony.
p5.why: in case = phòng khi (trời mưa).

p5.s: Volunteers must ------- a short training session before working at the event.
p5.why: complete a training session = hoàn thành buổi huấn luyện.

p5.s: The seminar was postponed ------- the speaker's illness.

p6.title: To: Valued Customers · From: FreshBox Meals · Subject: Holiday delivery schedule
p6.text: Dear Customer, Because of the national holiday on Monday, May 26, our delivery schedule {1} next week. Boxes normally delivered on Monday will arrive on Tuesday instead. {2} If you will not be home on Tuesday, you can choose a different delivery day in your account settings. {3}, you may skip next week's box entirely at no charge. We are grateful for your {4} and wish you a happy holiday. — The FreshBox Team

gaps.why: Lịch giao của tuần tới (next week) → tương lai: will change.

o: All other delivery days will not be affected.
Monday deliveries have been very popular this year.
Deliveries will continue as usual on Monday.
Tuesday is the only day we cannot deliver.
gaps.a: All other delivery days will not be affected.
gaps.why: Vừa nói đơn thứ Hai dời sang thứ Ba → các ngày giao khác không đổi. "Thứ Hai vẫn giao như thường", "thứ Ba là ngày duy nhất không giao" trái với đoạn; câu đơn thứ Hai được ưa chuộng không nối với ý dời lịch.
Đưa ra một lựa chọn khác (bỏ qua hộp tuần tới thay vì đổi ngày) → Alternatively. Therefore / Consequently chỉ kết quả, không hợp.
your + danh từ: patience (sự kiên nhẫn). patients = bệnh nhân.

p6.title: Summer Reading Challenge at Oakmont Library
p6.text: This summer, children ages six to twelve {1} to join our Summer Reading Challenge. Participants who read ten books between June 15 and August 15 will receive a certificate and a free pass to the Oakmont Science Center. {2} To sign up, simply visit the children's desk with a parent or guardian. Each participant will receive a reading log to keep track of the books they finish. {3}, the library will host a storytelling event every Wednesday morning in July. Space at these events is limited, so please {4} early. We hope to see many young readers this summer!

gaps.why: Trẻ em được mời (bị động, hiện tại): are invited.

o: Audiobooks and e-books also count toward the total.
Only children over twelve may take part.
The Science Center will be closed all summer.
Reading logs must be bought at the front desk.
gaps.a: Audiobooks and e-books also count toward the total.
gaps.why: Nói tiếp luật đọc đủ 10 cuốn → sách nói, sách điện tử cũng được tính. Ba câu kia trái với đoạn (trẻ 6–12 tuổi; vé vào Science Center là phần thưởng; sổ đọc được phát cho mỗi em).
Thêm một hoạt động nữa (kể chuyện mỗi sáng thứ Tư) → Furthermore.
please + động từ nguyên mẫu: register.

p6.title: Food Distributor Opens Training Kitchen
p6.text: Brennan Foods, the region's largest food distributor, opened a training kitchen at its headquarters last week. The kitchen, which {1} more than a year to build, will be used to teach cooking skills to local high school students who are interested in restaurant careers. Company president Lydia Brennan said the idea came from her own experience as a young cook. "Someone gave me a chance when I was seventeen," she said. {2} The program was funded with help from several local restaurants. Chefs from those restaurants will volunteer to {3} the classes. {4}, students who complete the twelve-week course will be offered paid summer jobs.

gaps.why: Bếp đã xây xong (mở tuần trước) → quá khứ: took.

o: She hopes the program will do the same for others.
The company plans to close the kitchen next year.
High school students are not eligible for the program.
Ms. Brennan has never worked in a restaurant.
gaps.a: She hopes the program will do the same for others.
gaps.why: Nối câu bà kể được cho cơ hội năm 17 tuổi → bà mong chương trình cũng cho người khác cơ hội như vậy. Ba câu kia trái với đoạn.
volunteer to + động từ nguyên mẫu: to lead.
Thêm một lợi ích nữa (việc làm hè có lương) → In addition.

p6.title: To: All Employees · From: Human Resources · Subject: Free health checks
p6.text: This year's free health screening {1} in the third-floor training room on June 10 and 11. A nurse from Westside Clinic will check blood pressure, cholesterol, and blood sugar. Each appointment takes about fifteen minutes, and the results are completely {2}. {3} To book a time, please use the sign-up link on the HR page by June 3. {4} you are unable to attend on either day, please contact HR to arrange a visit to the clinic instead.

gaps.why: Buổi khám diễn ra vào 10–11/6 (sắp tới, hạn đăng ký 3/6) → tương lai: will take place.
be + (trạng từ completely) + tính từ: confidential (được giữ bí mật).

o: Your results will be shared only with you.
Each appointment lasts about an hour.
The screening will be held at Westside Clinic.
Only managers are eligible for the screening.
gaps.a: Your results will be shared only with you.
gaps.why: Nối ý kết quả được giữ bí mật → chỉ gửi cho chính người khám. Ba câu kia trái với đoạn (mỗi lượt 15 phút; khám ở phòng đào tạo tầng 3; mọi nhân viên đều được khám).
Điều kiện: nếu không đến được cả hai ngày thì liên hệ HR → If. Because (vì) không hợp: chưa biết ai vắng.

docs.title: Article · Hollis Valley Gazette
docs.text:
Page Turner Adds a Café
Page Turner Books, a family-owned bookstore on Lark Avenue for over forty years, reopened on Saturday after adding a small café at the back of the store. Owner Delia Brooks said customers had long asked for a place to sit and read before buying. "People used to stand in the aisles for an hour," she said with a laugh. The café serves coffee, tea, and pastries from the bakery next door. To make room, the store moved its children's section upstairs, where it now has twice as much space. Ms. Brooks plans to hold author readings in the café one evening each month.

docs.text:
Farmers Market Finds a New Home
After twelve years in the parking lot of Baylor Mall, the Wren Bay Farmers Market will move to Harbor Green Park next month. [1] Market organizer Tomas Reyes said the mall's new owners plan to build apartments on the lot. [2] The park offers more shade and a playground, which Mr. Reyes believes will attract more families. [3] However, some vendors are worried about the lack of parking near the park. In response, the city has agreed to run a free shuttle from the Wren Bay train station every Saturday during market hours. [4] The market will continue to operate every Saturday from 8 A.M. to 1 P.M., and the number of vendors is expected to grow from 40 to 55.

docs.title: Product information · ClearVoice Conference Speaker
docs.text: The ClearVoice speaker lets everyone in a meeting room hear and be heard. One speaker covers a room of up to 8 people. For larger rooms, up to three speakers can be linked together, and each additional speaker covers 8 more people. The speaker connects to laptops by USB cable or Bluetooth, and its battery lasts up to 20 hours on a single charge. Price: $180 per speaker. Orders of three or more speakers ship free.

docs.title: E-mail · To: sales@clearvoice.com · From: Hana Kimura · Date: January 12
docs.text:
Hello,
Our organization is setting up a new meeting room for 20 people, and we are interested in the ClearVoice speaker. Most of our staff prefer not to use cables, so the speakers would need to connect wirelessly. Could you confirm that this will work? Also, do you offer a discount for nonprofit organizations? We are a small charity.
Regards,
Hana Kimura

docs.title: E-mail · To: Hana Kimura · From: ClearVoice Sales · Date: January 13
docs.text:
Dear Ms. Kimura,
Thank you for your interest. Yes, all ClearVoice speakers can connect by Bluetooth, so your staff will not need any cables. Nonprofit organizations receive 10 percent off every order; simply include your registration number when you order. If you would like to try the speakers first, we can lend you one for a week at no charge.
Sincerely,
Marco Bellini, ClearVoice Sales

qs.q: What is mentioned about the ClearVoice speaker?
qs.a: It can run on battery power.
w: It is sold only in sets of three.
qs.ev: its battery lasts up to 20 hours on a single charge
qs.why: Loa chạy pin, dùng tới 20 giờ mỗi lần sạc. Loa kết nối được cả bằng Bluetooth nên không bắt buộc cáp USB.

qs.q: How many speakers will Ms. Kimura's organization most likely need?
qs.ev: Our organization is setting up a new meeting room for 20 people
qs.why: Đối chiếu: mỗi loa đủ cho 8 người, nối tối đa 3 loa (24 người); 2 loa chỉ đủ 16 người → phòng 20 người cần 3 loa.

qs.q: How much will Ms. Kimura's organization most likely pay for the speakers before any discount?
qs.ev: Price: $180 per speaker.
qs.why: Đối chiếu: phòng 20 người cần 3 loa → 3 × $180 = $540 (mỗi loa đủ cho tám người; giá trước khi trừ phần giảm cho tổ chức phi lợi nhuận).

qs.q: What does Ms. Kimura ask about?
qs.ev: do you offer a discount for nonprofit organizations?
qs.why: Cô hỏi có giảm giá cho tổ chức phi lợi nhuận không.

qs.q: In the second e-mail, the word "try" is closest in meaning to
qs.ev: If you would like to try the speakers first
qs.why: try the speakers = dùng thử loa → test. attempt (cố gắng), judge (xét xử), taste (nếm) là nghĩa khác của try.
